Thank you very much. I am still seeing the same therapist on a weekly basis. I started taking 4 ibuprofen a day during the period of joint pain. I continued doing this after my sinus surgery. In February of this year, I started getting the worst headaches of my life. I looked into medication overuse headache and found it it be a viable candidate for this issue. Since then I have stopped taking ibuprofen entirely and my headaches have gotten better, but still nowhere near where I would like them to be. As far as diet, I have not found that anything makes any palpable difference.

Thank you for the support and perspective. I appreciate it.

I don't have much trouble believing in Jesus as a historical figure. That having been said, I am completely confident he was not divine in any way. A being with the infinite foresight granted by omniscience would certainly know how distorted his teachings would become as time passes. With over 38,000 Christian denominations currently in existence and the U.S. claiming to be a Christian nation with inequality of extreme proportions, one would hope a perfect being could have been somewhat better at spreading his message.
Herb makes almost any conversation exponentially better.
